Both Assistant A and Assistant B provided relevant and detailed responses to the user's questions. On the other hand, Assistant A suggested general natural remedies without directly addressing the possible causes of the user's discomfort related to pregnancy. Therefore, Assistant B provided a better answer to the second user question.
